_comment: Touge Nights' own settings, over the core's game.json key by key (see docs/modding.md, "game.json").
cars: the Kunos Japanese cars of 2002 and before, by id (their ui_car.json gives no year, so a year filter would drop them).
locale: dollars, as the core's, but kilometres and litres.
garage: Kunos' own showroom, which every Assetto Corsa has, until Touge Nights has a garage of its own.
tracks: the passes, by their ui_track.json tags, only their layouts so tagged (not drift: Kunos tags its GP circuits so;
a drag strip is always in; with none of these installed, every track).
